answer: Farming becomes a copper bet on surviving 63 epochs of grading, and every mesa settlement recomputes the tundra schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 63 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
